name: dms-workspace-osd
description: Dev tooling for the Workspace OSD Flash DMS plugin; DMS itself never reads this file

scripts.reload: dms ipc call plugin-scan reload workspaceOsdFlash
scripts.flash: dms ipc call wsosd flash 'Workspace 2: work' ''
scripts.test:hyprland: dms-testbed run hyprland --plugin . && dms-testbed open hyprland
